entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1
entries.words: Shift is done. Barge is tied.

variants.low: Mm. Late for shed talk.
variants.high: Fish heads are saved, if you are hungry.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1
entries.words: Soft feet. The clutch is asleep.

variants.low: Soft feet. Take the long path.
variants.high: Soft feet, friend. The fire is low but kind.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1
entries.words: Leave it where it lies. Up the terraces.

variants.low: Terraces, now. Off my path.
variants.high: Leave it, friend. I will say nothing. Up the terraces.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1
entries.words: Our slope again. The pot is warm.

variants.low: Our slope. The pot is spoken for already.
variants.high: Our slope again. A bowl is waiting for you.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1
entries.words: A dredging gang's families sleep here. Firm ground, with the Border road above and the marsh below. Poor camp, kept clean. I carry fish heads up to the shed.

variants.low: Families of a dredging gang sleep here. Border road above, marsh below, firm ground in the middle. Nothing to see. Fish heads wait on me.
variants.high: A dredging gang's families sleep here. Firm ground, Border road above, marsh below. The paths are swept, the thatch mended. Warm yourself at the cookfire.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1
entries.words: The shift starts down at the barge. The roll is read out aboard her, not in the camp. Families wait on the slope and hear none of it.

variants.low: Roll gets read on the barge, not in the camp. Families hear none of it. Ask the overseers, they like being asked.
variants.high: Roll gets read out on the barge, not in the camp. Families hear none of it. Go down to the pier at shift start, if you want the names.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1
entries.words: Argonian and Khajiit families live here. Two overseers keep the debts for the house, Llarvi Maryon and Nesh-Neel. I nod to them. My talk goes to the shed.

variants.low: Two overseers keep the debts, Llarvi Maryon and Nesh-Neel. Argonian and Khajiit families live here. That is all I say.
variants.high: Argonian and Khajiit families live here. Two overseers, Llarvi Maryon and Nesh-Neel, keep the debts. Tsanji carries the water up each morning. Ask her for a cup.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1
entries.words: Little climbs the slope. Gar and slugs stay in the shallows. The worse thing is the book. Food, fever and broken tools go onto the debt. It outgrows the shifts.

variants.low: Gar in the shallows, slugs too. The debt is worse. Food, fever and broken tools are added to it. See the book yourself.
variants.high: Little climbs the slope. Gar and slugs stay in the shallows. Mind your tools on the barge. A broken one goes onto the debt, as food and fever do.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1
entries.words: Up past the shed door, the Border road. Down the terraces, a stair to the landing, with the pier beside it. The west bank roots are not for me.

variants.low: Up is the road. Down is the stair, then the pier. Go.
variants.high: Up past the shed door is the Border road, the easy way out. Down the terraces, a stair reaches the landing. Go slowly, the boards are wet.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1
entries.words: A gang is hands in debt to House Dres. They dredge the channel off the barge, shift after shift. Wet work. I do not talk sums.

variants.low: Hands in debt to House Dres. They dredge the channel off the barge. That is the work.
variants.high: A gang is hands in debt to House Dres. They dredge the channel off the barge, wet and cold the whole shift. Bring a hot bowl at dusk.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1
entries.words: Mind the wet boards.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1
entries.words: Heads for the keeper.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-2
entries.words: Who stands at the shed? Speak.

variants.low: State your business, then go.
variants.high: Off the road with you, walker. Sit awhile.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-2
entries.words: Late to walk. Fire is banked.

variants.low: Too late for visitors. Shoo.
variants.high: It is late, you. Come to the banked fire, quietly.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-2
entries.words: You took from us. Climb away.

variants.low: Light fingers. Climb the terraces, now.
variants.high: You took from us. Climb away quietly.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-2
entries.words: Round again. Sit by the fire.

variants.low: Round again. The pot is not for you.
variants.high: Round at last. Sit, eat, tell me the road.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-2
entries.words: A dredging gang's families sleep here, on a dry slope below the Border road. I cook here, I haul water here, I say the shed names here.

variants.low: A dredging gang's families sleep here, on the slope below the Border road. That is all there is to see.
variants.high: A dredging gang's families sleep here, on a dry slope below the Border road. Come to the east shed at dusk, walker. A pot is on the fire.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-2
entries.words: The gang digs the channel from the barge, down the stair. The roll is read aboard it. Up here no name is called. We cook, we haul water.

variants.low: Down on the barge, the roll is read there. Never up here. Ask the overseers about the rest.
variants.high: The roll is read out on the barge, so we hear no name up here. If you walk down to the pier, mind the planks. They are wet before dawn.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-2
entries.words: The roll is the list of hands who owe the house. Every family here has a name on it. I know each by the hand on the roll.

variants.low: The roll lists the hands who owe the house. Every family here has a name on it. Ask no further.
variants.high: The roll is the list of hands who owe the house. Argonian families and Khajiit families, all of us have a name on it. Sal-Sei tends the shed.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-2
entries.words: Gar and slugs stay in the shallows. The danger is the debt. Food goes onto it, sickness goes onto it, a snapped spade goes onto it.

variants.low: Nothing on the slope. The debt is the danger. Meals go onto it, fever goes onto it, broken tools go onto it.
variants.high: Gar and slugs stay in the shallows, so wade there only by day. The danger is the debt. A meal goes onto it, a fever, a snapped spade.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-2
entries.words: Up past the shed door is the Border road. Down the stair is the water. Out the gang walk is Alten Corimont. The west roots are a climb.

variants.low: Up is the road. Down is the water. Pick one.
variants.high: Up past the shed door is the Border road. Down the stair is the water. The gang walk goes to Alten Corimont. Go slowly on the stair with a pack, walker.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-2
entries.words: Hands who owe House Dres dredge the channel off the barge. Once the shift ends, they sleep on land with the family. I say the shed names then.

variants.low: A hand dredges the channel off the barge. He sleeps on land with the family. That is the work.
variants.high: Hands who owe House Dres dredge the channel off the barge. At night, they sleep on land with the family. Come by the east shed after a shift and you will hear the names.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-2
entries.words: Aside. Full bucket.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-2
entries.words: Whose hand moved the bucket?

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
entries.words: Off the road. Was it clear?

variants.low: Pass the shed quickly. Its door stays shut to strangers.
variants.high: Down off the road at last. The pot is hot.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
entries.words: Dark road, walker. Which way did you come?

variants.low: Dark and late. Walk quickly.
variants.high: Come in to the fire, walker. The dark is long.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
entries.words: Leave now, before the overseers come.

variants.low: Overseers soon. Leave quickly.
variants.high: Go quietly, walker. I will watch the path.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
entries.words: You are back, walker.

variants.low: Back already. I have little time.
variants.high: You came back, walker. There is water.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
entries.words: The gang's families sleep on this slope. At the top, the clutch lies in the hatching shed, with the Border road just above it. I sleep in the west shed wearing my boots. The road is a short climb up the bank.

variants.low: Gang families sleep here. The clutch lies in the hatching shed at the top. I have nothing more for a walker.
variants.high: The gang's families sleep on this slope. At the top, the clutch lies in the hatching shed, kept warm all night. The cookfire below it is the best place to sit. The Border road is above for a walker who needs it.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
entries.words: The gang dredges the port channel off the barge that lies under the camp. The roll is called on the barge deck. Up here no name is heard. We learn who stood in the line when they climb the stair at dusk.

variants.low: The gang dredges off the barge. The roll is called there. I don't hear it from here.
variants.high: The gang dredges the port channel from the barge under us. The roll is called on its deck, so the camp learns the names at dusk from the hands. Come to the fire then and watch who climbs the stair.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
entries.words: Argonian and Khajiit families live here, each with a hand on the roll. Two overseers write their debts for the house, in the hut by the cookfire. I sit at the fire and see the doors they walk past.

variants.low: Argonian and Khajiit families live here. Two overseers write the debts. I have no more to say of them.
variants.high: Argonian and Khajiit families live here, cooking side by side. Two overseers write the debts for the house. Tsanji carries water past their door, if a walker wants a face to ask.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
entries.words: Slugs and gar stay in the shallows. The debt is the danger. I have seen a bowl of fish go onto it, then a fever, then a cracked haft. I sleep with my boots on and the Border road above me.

variants.low: Gar and slugs stay in the water. The debt is the danger. Food, fever, broken tools: all of it is added.
variants.high: Gar and slugs stay in the shallows, so the slope is safe to walk. The debt is what bites. A bowl of fish, a fever and a cracked haft all went onto one sum in the west shed this season.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
entries.words: Up from the shed door is the Border road. Down the terraces are the landing dock and the pier of the barge. That way ends at the barge. For Alten Corimont, cross the boardwalk, take the Border road, then two tracks, a few minutes each.

variants.low: Up is the Border road. Down is the dock.
variants.high: Up from the shed door is the Border road. Down the terraces are the landing dock and the pier of the barge. Alten Corimont is the port, a few minutes to each turning: boardwalk, road, then two tracks. The roots on the west bank climb out too.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
entries.words: A hand digs silt out of the channel from the barge all day, then sleeps on land with his family. The house adds his food to the debt. It adds his fever and any tool he breaks.

variants.low: A hand digs all day and sleeps on land with his family. Food, sickness, broken tools: all of it goes to the debt.
variants.high: A hand digs from the barge, then sleeps on land with his family at the fire. The house adds his food to the debt, then his fever, then any tool he breaks. Dives-Without-A-Rope says the families' names in order after each shift.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
entries.words: The roll is the gang's list of those who owe. Talk at the fire is that more grown ones go downriver on it every year. Its names are called on the barge. I don't know where downriver ends.

variants.low: Talk is that more grown ones go downriver every year. I know nothing else.
variants.high: Talk at the fire says more of the grown ones go downriver every year. The roll is the list of the gang's debtors. It is called aboard the barge only. Deesh-Duun mends nets at the shed corner and hears the rest.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
entries.words: Mind the stair.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
entries.words: Boots stay laced tight.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-4
entries.words: New face on the slope. Ri'Sakka says welcome, friend.

variants.low: Ri'Sakka has reed to cut, friend. Not now.
variants.high: Welcome, friend. Ri'Sakka has dry reed for your seat.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-4
entries.words: The reed is cut. Ri'Sakka is tired.

variants.low: Ri'Sakka is tired. Come at morning.
variants.high: Ri'Sakka is tired, friend, but sit a while by the fire.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-4
entries.words: Ri'Sakka has heard. The families will hear.

variants.low: Ri'Sakka saw. Leave the mats.
variants.high: Ri'Sakka saw that, friend. Put it right before the families hear.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-4
entries.words: Ri'Sakka sees you again, friend.

variants.low: Ri'Sakka has mats to mend. Speak quick.
variants.high: Friend! Ri'Sakka is glad of a face that pays.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-4
entries.words: It's the camp where the dredging gang's families live. Ri'Sakka patches the sleeping mats here, with reed from the store, so he knows every shed from the inside. The warmest roof is the hatching shed, up on the highest terrace. The gang's clutch lies there.

variants.low: A camp for the gang's families. The clutch is in the hatching shed up top. Ri'Sakka has mats to patch.
variants.high: It's the camp where the dredging gang's families live, friend. Ri'Sakka patches the sleeping mats here, with reed from the store, so he can find you a dry corner. The warmest roof is the hatching shed, up on the highest terrace, where the gang's clutch lies.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-4
entries.words: The gang works the port channel from the barge, down at the pier. The roll is read there before each shift, every name and what he owes. It is not read up in the camp. The families get it secondhand from whoever walks back, while I patch their mats.

variants.low: The gang dredges from the barge. The roll is read there, not here. Ask the hands.
variants.high: The gang works the port channel from the barge, down at the pier. The roll gets read there before each shift. The families up here only hear it secondhand from whoever walks back, friend. Ri'Sakka patches the mats while they wait.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-4
entries.words: Argonian families and Khajiit families share the terraces. The clutch-keeper minds the shed. Two overseers write the debts. The roll is the list of hands who owe the house, with a family behind each name. The shed families count Ri'Sakka a hand, not kin. He patches their mats all the same.

variants.low: Argonians and Khajiit, two overseers, a clutch-keeper. The roll is the list of hands who owe the house. Ri'Sakka patches mats.
variants.high: Argonian families and Khajiit families share the terraces, friend. The clutch-keeper minds the shed. Two overseers write the debts. The roll is the list of hands who owe the house, with a family behind each name. Ri'Sakka patches mats for all of them, kin or hand.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-4
entries.words: Little hunts the slope. Gar and slugs stay in the shallows. Torchbugs drift over the reeds, so a mat-patcher sleeps easy. The debt is what bites. Food, sickness and broken tools are all added to it, faster than the gang can work it off.

variants.low: Gar in the shallows, torchbugs in the reeds. The debt is worse. Food, fever and broken tools go on it.
variants.high: Little hunts the slope, friend. Gar and slugs stay in the shallows, torchbugs drift over the reeds. The debt is what bites. Food, sickness and broken tools are all added to it, faster than the gang can work it off.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-4
entries.words: Up past the hatching shed door is the Border road. Down the stair is the landing, with the barge pier beside it. For Alten Corimont, cross the boardwalk south-west, then the Border road north, then the tracks east and south, a few minutes at each turn. The west bank roots are a hard climb with a pack.

variants.low: Up is the road. Down the stair is the pier. Alten Corimont is the boardwalk south-west, then road and tracks.
variants.high: Up past the hatching shed door is the Border road, friend. Down the stair is the landing, with the barge pier beside it. For Alten Corimont, cross the boardwalk south-west, then the Border road north, then the tracks east and south. A few minutes at each turn.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-4
entries.words: I patch mats for the hands who do it, so I see them come in at dusk. Dredging is wet, heavy work. The house writes the meals against a hand, then the fevers, then every spade that cracks in the silt. A hand can work the whole season and owe more at the end of it.

variants.low: Wet, heavy work, dredging. The house adds the meals, the fevers and the broken spades to what a hand owes.
variants.high: I patch mats for the hands who do it, friend, so I see them come in at dusk. Dredging is wet, heavy work. The house writes the meals against a hand, then the fevers, then every cracked spade. A hand can work the whole season and owe more at the end.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-4
entries.words: Mind the mats, friend.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-4
entries.words: Reed, then needle.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-5
entries.words: The water is up already, traveller.

variants.low: Out of the path, traveller.
variants.high: Traveller, sit. The first jar is still cool.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-5
entries.words: Only embers now. Sleep well.

variants.low: Embers only. Go to bed.
variants.high: Only embers now, walker. Sleep well.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-5
entries.words: Put back what you took. This one tallies the jars.

variants.low: Hands off the jars. They are tallied.
variants.high: Put it back and this one says nothing. The jars are tallied at dusk.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-5
entries.words: A face that pays its way. The jars are full.

variants.low: The jars are full. Go and sit.
variants.high: A face that pays its way. Take a cup, walker.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-5
entries.words: Gang Ground is where the dredging gang's families live. The camp sits on firm ground, with the Border road above it and the marsh below. This one carries water up the slope each morning. A full jar is a long climb.

variants.low: It is the gang's camp, on firm ground under the Border road. This one has a jar to carry.
variants.high: Gang Ground is where the dredging gang's families live, on a slope of firm ground below the Border road. Come up to the cookfire, walker. This one will find you a cup of water.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-5
entries.words: The gang digs out the port channel. They go aboard the barge at the foot of the slope. The roll is read on that barge, not in the camp, so the names stay down there. This one stays up here with the water jars.

variants.low: The roll is read on the barge, not up here. The channel is the gang's work. Mine is the water.
variants.high: The gang digs the port channel off the barge down at the pier. At the start of a shift, they hear the roll read on the barge, not up at the camp. The pier is a short way down if you want to see it.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-5
entries.words: Families of the hands live here, Argonian and Khajiit. Sal-Sei tends the clutch in the warm shed. Llarvi Maryon and Nesh-Neel are the two overseers who write up the gang's debts. The House adds to them faster than the gang can dig.

variants.low: Families, Argonian and Khajiit. Sal-Sei tends the shed. Two overseers write up the debts.
variants.high: Argonian and Khajiit families share the camp. This one is glad of the company. Sal-Sei tends the warm shed. Llarvi Maryon and Nesh-Neel are the two overseers who write up the gang's debts. Nesh-Neel walks the yard at dusk.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-5
entries.words: Little hunts this slope. The slugs and gar stay in the shallows. The torchbugs stay in the reeds. The climb with a full jar is the hard part. The overseers' ledger bites harder than any gar.

variants.low: Not much. Slugs and gar stay in the water. Walk the slope and you will be fine.
variants.high: Stay on the terraces and the paths, walker. You will meet nothing worse than a torchbug. The slugs and gar stay in the shallows and the torchbugs in the reeds.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-5
entries.words: From the hatching shed, a way climbs to the Border road. Another goes down the slope to the landing and the pier. Alten Corimont is four short stretches of a few minutes each, starting with the boardwalk south-west.

variants.low: Up from the shed is the Border road. Down is the landing and the pier.
variants.high: Up from the hatching shed you reach the Border road. Down the stair are the landing and the pier by the barge. Alten Corimont is four short stretches of a few minutes each, starting with the boardwalk south-west. This one can point you at the boardwalk.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-5
entries.words: Hands in a gang are in debt to House Dres. They dig the channel to work it off. The House adds to the sum faster than they dig. This one carries water up for the families while the hands are away.

variants.low: The hands owe House Dres. They dig to work it off. That is all this one will say.
variants.high: Hands in a gang are in debt to House Dres. They dig the channel to work it off. The House adds to the sum faster than they dig. This one carries water up for the families. A full jar is always welcome.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-5
entries.words: Jars coming. Clear the path.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-5
entries.words: Another climb done.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3
entries.words: Your name, walker. It goes in the book.

variants.low: Not at my fire.
variants.high: Your name, walker. I'll write it in a clean hand.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3
entries.words: Two entries left to close. The lamp's low.

variants.low: Lamp's low. Tomorrow.
variants.high: Two entries left to close. Sit if you like, the lamp's low.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3
entries.words: I'm entering that at the full price.

variants.low: Full price. Pay or go.
variants.high: I'm entering that at the full price. Pay it down and we're square.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3
entries.words: Nothing against your name yet, outlander.

variants.low: Nothing against you yet.
variants.high: Still nothing against your name, outlander. I'm glad of it.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3
entries.words: I'm one of the two overseers here, the one who sits by the fire with the house's ledger on my lap. This is Gang Ground, the camp for the gang's families. Up on the top terrace stands the hatching shed with the clutch inside it. Every morning the first cup of water goes to its door before I've eaten.

variants.low: Overseer, by the fire. This is Gang Ground, the gang's camp. The clutch is in the shed up top. I'm not taking visitors up there.
variants.high: I'm one of the two overseers here, the one by the fire with the ledger. This is Gang Ground, the gang's camp. Up on the top terrace stands the hatching shed with the clutch inside it. It's the warmest spot on the slope. Take the warm side of the fire while you're here, outlander.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3
entries.words: The gang dredges the port channel from the barge down at the pier. Before every shift starts, the roll gets read out on that barge. It's never read up here in the camp. The channel stays open and the debts come down by it. The families do the rest: the water, the cooking and the shed.

variants.low: The gang dredges the channel off the barge. The roll is read out there, never in the camp. Ask the families about their own chores.
variants.high: The gang dredges the port channel from the barge at the pier. Before each shift, the roll is read out on that barge, never in the camp. The channel stays open and the debts come down by it, so the work's good. Come down to the pier at the start of a shift and watch the barge fill.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3
entries.words: Argonian families and Khajiit families live here, quiet enough while the clutch stays warm. The roll names every hand who owes the house. Each family is a line on my page to me, with a balance to bring down. I know their faces too. The page is what I read first.

variants.low: Argonians and Khajiit, mostly quiet. The roll names every hand who owes the house. That's all you need of them.
variants.high: Argonian families and Khajiit families live here, quiet enough while the clutch stays warm. The roll names every hand who owes the house. Each family is a line on my page with a balance to bring down. If you want one in particular, give me the name and I'll find the terrace.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3
entries.words: Little hunts the slope. By my tally, the shallows hold six torchbugs, three gar and two slugs. They stay down there. The real cost up here is a broken tool. Every snapped spade or hoe goes on the debt. Then the debt grows with it.

variants.low: Little hunts the slope. Gar and slugs stay in the shallows. Broken tools go on the debt.
variants.high: Little hunts the slope. By my tally, the shallows hold six torchbugs, three gar and two slugs. They stay down there. A snapped tool costs more than any bite. It goes on the debt. Watch your feet on the strand, outlander.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3
entries.words: Up past the hatching shed you reach the Border road. Down the terraces, a stair leads to the landing. The barge pier is next to it. For Alten Corimont, cross the boardwalk, then go north on the Border road, then take the tracks. A few minutes each turn. The west bank has a climb out over two Hist roots.

variants.low: Up is the Border road. Down is the landing and the pier. Alten Corimont is by the boardwalk and the road. The roots on the west bank are a hard climb.
variants.high: Up past the hatching shed you reach the Border road. Down the terraces, a stair leads to the landing. The barge pier is next to it. For Alten Corimont, cross the boardwalk, then go north on the Border road, then take the tracks, a few minutes at each turning. The west bank has a climb out over two Hist roots, but I'd leave a pack at the fire first.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3
entries.words: There are two of us on the gang's debts, working for House Dres. Dres was a slaving house up north until the Wardens stole the north off it. My seat is the bench at the fire, with the ledger on my knee. Nesh-Neel goes round the doors at dusk, one by one.

variants.low: Two of us handle the debts, for Dres, the old slaving house. I take the ledger. The other tries the doors at dusk.
variants.high: Two of us handle the gang's debts for House Dres. Dres was a slaving house before the Wardens stole the north from it. I'll air that grievance whenever you've an hour. My seat is the fire, with the ledger on my knee. Nesh-Neel goes round the doors at dusk.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3
entries.words: Mind my lamp.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3
entries.words: Cracked pole. Full price.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3-2
entries.words: Business here, stranger, yes?

variants.low: Your business, or off with you.
variants.high: Welcome to the yard, stranger. Business or a visit?

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3-2
entries.words: Doors are latched. Up to the road.

variants.low: Latched for the night.
variants.high: Doors are latched, stranger. Use the road till morning.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3-2
entries.words: Come with me.

variants.low: Put it down.
variants.high: Set it down. Come with me to the hut, stranger.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3-2
entries.words: You did as you said. The yard is open.

variants.low: You did as you said. Go ahead.
variants.high: You did as you said, stranger. Sit at the cookfire.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3-2
entries.words: This is Gang Ground, where the families of the dredging gang live. I'm an overseer here for the house. At dusk, I walk the yard and try every door. Shut, yes? Shut, all of them. It's poor ground but swept clean.

variants.low: Gang Ground, the dredging gang's camp. I'm an overseer here, so say what you want or go back up to the road.
variants.high: This is Gang Ground, the camp of the dredging gang's families. I'm an overseer here. Come by the yard at dusk and I'll walk you round it. It's poor ground, but it's clean.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3-2
entries.words: The gang dredges the port channel, working off the barge down at the water. The roll gets read out on the deck before a shift. It isn't read up here, because I won't have names said over the families' cooking pots. The channel work does wear a debt down in time.

variants.low: The gang works the channel off the barge. The roll is read on the deck, not in the camp. The house wants it so.
variants.high: The gang dredges the port channel off the barge below us. The roll is read there on the deck. Up in the camp, it isn't. Walk down at the start of a shift and you'll hear it. The work wears a debt down in time. I'll show you the sums if you ask.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3-2
entries.words: There are two overseers here, Llarvi and me. We tally what the gang owes the house, hand by hand. The families are Argonian and Khajiit. I know them by their doors, since I try each one at dusk. They're quiet as long as the eggs are warm.

variants.low: Two overseers here, Llarvi and me. The families are Argonian and Khajiit. They give me no trouble and you'll give them none.
variants.high: There are two overseers here, Llarvi and me. Llarvi sits at the fire with the book most evenings. I'm out in the yard. The families are Argonian and Khajiit. You'll find easy company at the cookfire.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3-2
entries.words: Little hunts the slope. Gar and slugs stay in the shallows. Torchbugs hang over the reeds. I tell the families to stay out of the water after dark.

variants.low: Little hunts the slope. Stay out of the shallows after dark.
variants.high: Little hunts the slope. Gar and slugs stay in the shallows. Torchbugs hang over the reeds. After dark, the water is the only place I'd warn you off. The yard itself is safe to walk.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3-2
entries.words: Up past the shed door, you reach the Border road. Down the terraces, the stair ends at the landing, with the barge's pier beside it. The gang walk goes on to Alten Corimont. On the west bank, a pair of Hist roots makes a steep way out. I don't send strangers over them.

variants.low: Up is the Border road. Down is the barge. The gang walk goes to Alten Corimont.
variants.high: Up past the shed door, you reach the Border road. Down the terraces, the stair ends at the landing, with the barge's pier beside it. The stair is two flights, so go steady. The gang walk goes on to Alten Corimont. I'll point you from the shed door myself.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3-2
entries.words: There are two overseers, Llarvi and me. The house we answer to is Dres, a slaving house from the old days. We tally what the gang owes it. I serve it for a wage. The grudge against the north isn't mine to carry. Llarvi has the ledger by the fire. At dusk, I try each door. Latched, yes? Latched.

variants.low: There are two overseers. Llarvi has the ledger and a seat by the fire. I try each door at dusk. House Dres is a slaving house from the old days. Think what you like of it.
variants.high: There are two overseers, Llarvi and me. The house we answer to is Dres, a slaving house from the old days. We tally what the gang owes it. Llarvi has the ledger and a seat by the fire. I try each door at dusk. Come along on my round if you want to see it.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3-2
entries.words: Doors shut by dusk.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3-2
entries.words: Llarvi wants the numbers.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-clutch-keeper
entries.words: Welcome, guest. The door shuts best with a push.

variants.low: Door. Shut it.
variants.high: Welcome, guest. The warmest spot is the nest wall.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-clutch-keeper
entries.words: Softly, guest. The eggs are asleep.

variants.low: Soft. The eggs sleep.
variants.high: Softly, guest. Sit by the door if you like.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-clutch-keeper
entries.words: Get out. The eggs are not yours.

variants.low: Out. Go now.
variants.high: Out. I will not say it twice.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-clutch-keeper
entries.words: Back again, guest. Come in to the warmth.

variants.low: Ah, you. Enter, then.
variants.high: Guest, welcome back. Come and sit by the warm wall.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-clutch-keeper
entries.words: The camp is on firm earth, with the Border road above it and the marsh below. The top terrace is the driest, so the hatching shed stands there. I spend my days in it. Lower down, the damp gets into everything.

variants.low: Firm earth, between the road and the marsh. The shed is at the top. You have no business there.
variants.high: The camp sits on firm earth, with the Border road over the roofs and the marsh at the bottom. Come up to the shed if you want to feel what dry is. The top terrace is the only place I trust to stay that way.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-clutch-keeper
entries.words: The gang dredges the port channel from the barge below us. The roll of names is read out aboard it, never in the camp. I have no part in that work. My place is the shed, where it is dry and the air is warm.

variants.low: They dredge from the barge. The roll is read out there, not here. Ask the barge.
variants.high: The gang dredges the port channel from the barge at the foot of the slope. That is where the roll is read out, never up here. Go down in the morning if you want to see it. I would not stand on that wet deck myself.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-clutch-keeper
entries.words: Argonian and Khajiit families live on the slope, each with a hand on the roll. The roll is the house's list of hands who owe it. Two overseers write the sums. The families bring water to my door each morning.

variants.low: Argonian and Khajiit families. Each has a hand on the roll, the list of those who owe the house. Two overseers write it.
variants.high: Argonian and Khajiit families live here, each with a hand on the roll, the house's list of those who owe it. Two overseers write the sums. The families are good to the shed. I tell them so.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-clutch-keeper
entries.words: Little hunts the slope. Slugs and gar stay in the shallows. The torchbugs hover over the reeds. The sums in the overseers' book are the worse danger, because a broken tool adds to them.

variants.low: Little hunts the slope. Slugs and gar stay in the shallows. The book of sums does the harm.
variants.high: Little hunts the slope. The slugs and gar stay in the water. The torchbugs drift over the reeds. Wear dry boots near the shallows. The worst of the camp is the book of sums, which a broken tool makes longer.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-clutch-keeper
entries.words: Up from the shed door is the Border road. Down the terraces are the water, a dock and the barge. The gang walk leads from the barge to the port. A harder way climbs over two great roots. I have not tried it.

variants.low: Up is the road. Down is the pier. Pick one and go.
variants.high: Up from my door is the Border road, the easy way out. Down the terraces you reach the water, with a dock and the barge. From the barge the gang walk leads to the port. The two great roots on the west bank are a climb for sure feet.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-clutch-keeper
entries.words: Each clutch is the eggs of one family. I tend them until they hatch. Under my hand, the shed fire stays low. The nest stays dry. I lay fresh reed from the basket at the door. Warm is good. Damp is not.

variants.low: I tend a family's eggs until they hatch. The fire is low, the nest dry, the reed in the basket at the door. That is all.
variants.high: I tend a family's eggs until they hatch, which means a low fire and a dry nest. The reed is in the basket at the door. Bring me an armful from the dry side of the terrace and I will lay it down gladly.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-clutch-keeper
entries.words: Softly now.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-clutch-keeper
entries.words: Warm shed, full nest.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
entries.words: Which family is yours?

variants.low: Wrong terrace for strangers. Leave us, please.
variants.high: Which family is yours, visitor? I can point you to any of them.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
entries.words: The light is too poor for nets. Sit down if you like.

variants.low: Too dark to see your face. Stay on the planks.
variants.high: Too dark for nets now. Sit down, visitor. The cookfire is close.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
entries.words: Every family will know of this by dusk.

variants.low: I saw what you did. Do not ask me to forget it.
variants.high: Every family will know by dusk. I can tell you who saw, visitor.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
entries.words: I know your face, visitor.

variants.low: Your face is known to me. That is no kindness.
variants.high: I know your face, visitor. Sit, the nets can wait.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
entries.words: I mend nets at the corner of the west shed, where every family walks past me. Up the slope, on the top terrace, stands the hatching shed with the eggs in it. Nothing in the camp is kept as warm and clean as that shed. The gang goes down to dredge from the barge. So the camp is left to us. At dusk, the low hum from that shed carries down as far as my nets.

variants.low: Gang Ground is where the families sleep. The eggs are in the hatching shed on the top terrace, up the slope. That's all I'll say to a stranger while I've nets to mend.
variants.high: I mend nets at the west shed's corner, so sit if you like. Up on the top terrace is the hatching shed, where the eggs lie. It's warm in there all night. Once the camp goes quiet you can hear it hum from here.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
entries.words: The hands go down to the barge when every shift begins and dredge the port channel. I never go aboard. My work is netting, which is small beside theirs. When they climb back up the stair I read the day off their shoulders. The house writes the sums larger by morning than the gang can dredge them down. The families keep the camp. They carry the water up the slope and save the fish heads for the clutch-keeper.

variants.low: The hands dredge the channel off the barge. The families keep the camp. That is all of it and I've nets to mend.
variants.high: The hands dredge the port channel from the barge below. I sit up here and mend, which is small work beside theirs. If you walk the camp, keep to the terraces and leave the shed door be.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
entries.words: Argonian families live here. Khajiit families do too. Each has a hand on the roll. Tsanji's people carry the water up. The family with Ties-The-Loose-Plank on the roll saves the fish heads. Two overseers keep the sums for the house. They're Llarvi Maryon and Nesh-Neel. Sal-Sei tends the clutch in the shed.

variants.low: Argonian families, Khajiit families. Two overseers, Llarvi Maryon and Nesh-Neel. Sal-Sei tends the clutch. Ask me who has a hand on the roll and you'll get no answer.
variants.high: Argonian families live here, and so do Khajiit families. Tsanji's family carries the water up each day, so you'll meet her on the slope. The overseers are Llarvi Maryon and Nesh-Neel. They keep the book by the cookfire. Sal-Sei tends the clutch.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
entries.words: Not much hunts the slope. I've sat here long enough to say so. Slugs and gar keep to the shallows. Torchbugs hang over the reeds. None of them has torn a net of mine. What bites is the book. Every broken tool is written against the gang. The house adds faster than the hands can dredge.

variants.low: Little hunts the slope. Slugs, gar and torchbugs stay by the water. The book is worse and I'm not saying more.
variants.high: Little hunts the slope, so you can walk it freely. The slugs and gar stay in the shallows. Torchbugs hang over the reeds. The real danger is the overseers' book, where every broken tool is added against the gang.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
entries.words: From the hatching shed you go up to the Border road. Going down, take the stair to the landing, with the barge pier beside it. If you want Alten Corimont, take the gang walk. It's the way the hands go out to the port. There's a rough way out too on the west bank. You climb along the two Hist roots. I wouldn't send a stranger up them with a pack.

variants.low: Up past the shed is the Border road. Down the stair are the landing and the barge pier. The gang walk reaches Alten Corimont. The west bank has a root climb and I'd not try it.
variants.high: From the hatching shed, the path up reaches the Border road. Down the stair you come to the landing, with the barge pier beside it. The gang walk runs to Alten Corimont. There's a way out on the west bank too. You climb along the two Hist roots. That climb is hard going with a pack.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
entries.words: I know each family in this camp and every name on the roll. The roll is the house's list of the hands that owe it. Its names are called aboard the barge and nowhere in the camp. It's a small post, sitting at the nets. Everyone passes my corner, so if something's done in the camp I can tell you who saw it.

variants.low: The roll is the house's list of the hands that owe it. Its names are called aboard the barge, never up here. I know every family and every name on it. If a thing is done here, I know who saw it. That is not for strangers.
variants.high: The roll is the house's list of the hands that owe it. Its names are called aboard the barge, not in the camp. I know every family and every name on it. If you've a thing to ask about this camp, I'll tell you who saw it.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
entries.words: The talk at my nets is that the roll sends more grown hands downriver every year. It lists the gang's debtors. Its names are called aboard the barge, never up in the camp. How many have come back I leave unsaid. You needn't ask the families either. My own guess is that the house means to settle its sums where the gang cannot see.

variants.low: The roll sends more grown hands downriver every year. That's the talk. The roll lists the gang's debtors and its names are called aboard the barge, never in the camp. The rest isn't for you.
variants.high: The talk at my nets is that the roll sends more grown hands downriver each year. The roll lists the gang's debtors. Its names are called aboard the barge, never in the camp. If you want to hear the families on it, sit here a while. They pass my corner by dusk.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
entries.words: Step wide of the nets.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
entries.words: Bad knot again.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-2
entries.words: Alten Corimont? A river port, eastern Shadowfen. Argonian pirates and smugglers run it, taking no side. Any crew can tie up. The gangs are hired off its docks.

variants.low: A river port, eastern Shadowfen. Pirates and smugglers run it, taking no side. Gangs are hired off its docks.
variants.high: A river port, eastern Shadowfen. Argonian pirates and smugglers run it, taking no side. Any crew can tie up. Gangs are hired off its docks. Ask for the harbour.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-2
entries.words: A dredging gang's families live in this camp, on the dry slope below the Border road. The hatching shed stands on the top terrace, the clutch inside it.

variants.low: A camp for a dredging gang's families below the Border road. The clutch is in the hatching shed on the top terrace. Leave it be.
variants.high: A dredging gang's families live in this camp, on the dry slope below the Border road. The hatching shed stands on the top terrace. Leave a cup of water at its door.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-2
entries.words: Imperial work, all of it: Prison road, Border road, Mile House waystation. The old names stuck. Toward the Rose goes the Prison road, the Tag House on a dry rise beside it.

variants.low: Old Imperial roads and a waystation: Prison, Border, Mile House. The names are old. Toward the Rose goes the Prison road. The Tag House sits on a dry rise by it.
variants.high: Imperial work, all of it: Prison road, Border road, Mile House waystation. The old names stuck. Toward the Rose goes the Prison road, the Tag House on a dry rise beside it. Mind the mud.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
entries.words: Alten Corimont is a port on a river in the east of Shadowfen, where a waterway goes out to the sea. Pirates and smugglers of our people run it. They stay out of every war, so any crew ties up at its docks. The channel gangs are hired there.

variants.low: Alten Corimont is the port downriver. Argonian smugglers run it. It takes no side.
variants.high: Alten Corimont stands on a river in the east of Shadowfen, on a waterway that goes out to the sea. Argonian pirates and smugglers run it. They stay out of every war, so any crew ties up at its docks. The channel gangs are hired there.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
entries.words: The gang's families sleep on firm ground with the marsh below and the Border road above. The camp is forty years old. Only the top terrace stays dry, so the hatching shed stands there. The clutch lies in it. That is why the families stay.

variants.low: Gang Ground is the camp of the gang's families. The clutch is in the shed at the top.
variants.high: The gang's families sleep on firm ground with the marsh below and the Border road above. The camp is forty years old. Only the top terrace stays dry, so the hatching shed stands there. The clutch lies in it. The families stay for the eggs.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
entries.words: The Empire built the Border road above us, the Prison road and the Mile House waystation. People still use the old names. The Prison road heads for the Rose. The Tag House sits on a dry rise beside it.

variants.low: The Border road and the Prison road are old Imperial roads. I have not walked the second.
variants.high: The Empire built the Border road above us, the Prison road and the Mile House waystation. People still use the old names. The Prison road heads for the Rose. The Tag House sits on a dry rise beside it. I know only the Border road.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-4
entries.words: A river port in the east of Shadowfen, where the waterway runs down to the sea. Argonian smugglers and pirates run the docks. They'll sell to any crew and won't pick a side in a quarrel. The gangs who dredge the lower channel are hired through those same docks.

variants.low: A pirate port on the river to the sea. Smugglers run the docks. Dredging gangs are hired there.
variants.high: Friend, it's a river port in the east of Shadowfen, where the waterway runs down to the sea. Argonian smugglers and pirates run the docks. They'll sell to any crew and won't pick a side in a quarrel. The dredging gangs of the lower channel are hired through those docks.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-4
entries.words: The camp stands on firm earth where the Border road ends and the marsh starts. Forty years it has been there, with a dredging gang's families in it. The highest terrace is dry, so they built a hatching shed there. The gang's eggs lie in it. The families stay for those eggs.

variants.low: A dredging gang's camp, forty years old, on firm earth. The eggs in the hatching shed keep the families here.
variants.high: Friend, the camp stands on firm earth where the Border road ends and the marsh starts. It's forty years old, with a dredging gang's families in it. The highest terrace is dry enough for a hatching shed, so the gang's eggs lie there. They are why the families stay.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-4
entries.words: The Border road passes over our roofs. Another road heads to the Rose. Ri'Sakka has seen the Tag House by that road, on higher ground. The Mile House is a waystation. All three are old Imperial work. People still call them by the old names.

variants.low: Old Imperial roads and a waystation. We use the old names still.
variants.high: The Border road passes over our roofs, friend. Another road runs toward the Rose, with the Tag House by it on higher ground. The Mile House is a waystation. All three are old Imperial work. People call them by the old names still.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-5
entries.words: A dredging gang's families live in the camp. It is forty years old. It stands on firm ground, with the Border road above and the marsh below. On the dry top terrace, a hatching shed holds the clutch. The families stay for the eggs.

variants.low: A dredging gang's families live here. The clutch is in the shed on the top terrace.
variants.high: It is the camp of a dredging gang's families. The top terrace is dry, so the hatching shed stands there with the clutch inside. This one carries water up to that door each morning. The Border road is above and the marsh is below.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-5
entries.words: Alten Corimont is a port on a river in eastern Shadowfen. Argonian pirates and smugglers run it. It takes no side in a war. Any crew may tie up there. The gangs that dredge the lower channel are hired from its docks. Bring coin.

variants.low: A river port in eastern Shadowfen. Pirates run it. Bring coin.
variants.high: Alten Corimont is a port on a river in eastern Shadowfen. Argonian pirates and smugglers run it. It takes no side in a war, so any crew may tie up. The gangs that dredge the lower channel are hired from its docks. Khajiit hulls put in there as well.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-5
entries.words: Two old Imperial roads are the Prison road and the Border road. The Mile House is a waystation from the same time. Folk still use the old names. The Tag House stands on a dry rise beside the Prison road.

variants.low: Old Imperial roads. The Tag House stands by the Prison road.
variants.high: Two old Imperial roads are the Prison road and the Border road. The Mile House is a waystation from the same time. Folk still use the old names. The Tag House stands on a dry rise beside the Prison road. The Prison road runs toward the Rose.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1
entries.words: Alten Corimont lies on a waterway in eastern Shadowfen, a port for river boats. Argonian pirates and smugglers run it. It sides with no war, so any crew may tie up. Gangs like ours are hired from its docks.

variants.low: River port in eastern Shadowfen. Argonian pirates and smugglers run it. It sides with no war. Gangs get hired at its docks. I do not go.
variants.high: Alten Corimont is a river port in eastern Shadowfen. Argonian pirates and smugglers run it. It sides with no war, so any crew may tie up. Dredging gangs are hired at its docks. Ask there.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1
entries.words: A dredging gang's families live in Gang Ground, on firm earth under the Border road with the marsh at the foot. The clutch lies in the warm shed on the top terrace. That keeps the families here.

variants.low: Camp of a dredging gang's families. Firm earth under the Border road, marsh at the foot. The clutch is in the top shed. Leave the fire be.
variants.high: Gang Ground is a dredging gang's camp, on firm earth under the Border road with the marsh at the foot. The clutch lies in the warm top shed. Stand at the door and hear it hum.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1
entries.words: The Empire laid the Prison road and the Mile House waystation, with the Border road too. Folk keep the old names. The Prison road heads for the Rose. A dry rise beside it holds the Tag House.

variants.low: Old Imperial roads and a waystation, the Mile House. Folk keep the old names. Prison road heads for the Rose. Tag House sits on a rise by it.
variants.high: The Empire laid the Prison road, the Mile House waystation and the Border road. Folk keep the old names. The Prison road heads for the Rose, with the Tag House on a dry rise by it.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3-2
entries.words: Gang Ground is the camp of the dredging gang's families. It's about forty years old, on firm ground with the Border road above and the marsh below. The hatching shed stands on the top terrace, where the ground stays dry. The clutch of the gang's eggs lies inside. The families stay on for the eggs.

variants.low: Gang Ground: the dredging gang's camp, forty years old, on firm ground under the Border road. The hatching shed is on the top terrace, dry, with the clutch inside. The families stay for the eggs.
variants.high: Gang Ground is the camp of the dredging gang's families. It's about forty years old, on firm ground with the Border road above and the marsh below. The hatching shed stands on the top terrace, where the ground stays dry. The clutch lies inside. I'll walk you as far as the shed door.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3-2
entries.words: Alten Corimont lies in eastern Shadowfen, a river port where the waterway goes down to the sea. Pirates and smugglers run it, Argonians all. They pick no side in a war. Any crew can tie up at its docks. Dredging gangs, ours among them, are hired at those docks.

variants.low: Alten Corimont: a port up the river in eastern Shadowfen. Pirates and smugglers run it, Argonians all. It takes no side in a war. Dredging gangs are hired at its docks.
variants.high: Alten Corimont lies in eastern Shadowfen, a river port where the waterway goes down to the sea. Pirates and smugglers run it, Argonians all. They pick no side in a war. Any crew can tie up at its docks. Dredging gangs, ours among them, are hired there. The gang walk gets you there. I'll point the way from the shed door.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3-2
entries.words: The Mile House is an old Imperial waystation. The Prison road and Border road were laid by the Empire as well. Folk still use the old names for all three. I've no love for any of them. The Border road runs over our roofs. The Prison road goes toward the Rose, with the Tag House on a dry rise beside it.

variants.low: Imperial roads and a waystation, called by their old names: Prison road, Border road, Mile House. The Prison road goes toward the Rose. The Tag House stands on a dry rise beside it.
variants.high: The Mile House is an old Imperial waystation. The Prison road and Border road were laid by the Empire as well. Folk still use the old names for all three. The Border road is the one over our roofs, so you'll know it. The Prison road goes toward the Rose, with the Tag House on a dry rise beside it.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3
entries.words: East in Shadowfen there's a port called Alten Corimont, up a waterway from the sea. Smugglers and Argonian pirates are the ones in charge. Whoever fights whom, the port stays out of it. Any crew may moor at its docks. The gangs that dredge the lower channel are hired there.

variants.low: A pirate port in eastern Shadowfen, on a waterway to the sea. Neutral in every war. Gangs are hired at its docks.
variants.high: East in Shadowfen there's a port called Alten Corimont, up a waterway from the sea. Smugglers and Argonian pirates are in charge. The port stays out of every war. Any crew may moor. Gangs for the lower channel are hired at its docks, so read the terms before you sign, outlander.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3
entries.words: Forty years or near enough, this camp has been home to the gang's families. The ground is firm here, with the Border road above and the marsh below. The top terrace is dry, so that's where the hatching shed went. The gang's clutch lies inside. The eggs are what ties the families to the place.

variants.low: A camp for the gang's families, forty years old, with the road above and the marsh below. The clutch is in the top shed. Stay off the terraces.
variants.high: Forty years or near enough, this camp has been home to the gang's families. The ground is firm here, with the Border road above and the marsh below. The top terrace is dry, so that's where the hatching shed went. The gang's clutch lies inside. The eggs are what ties the families to the place. You may look from the path, outlander.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3
entries.words: The Border road over our roofs is an old Imperial road, same as the Prison road. The Mile House is an old waystation. The old names stuck, so I use them too. The Tag House sits on a dry rise beside the Prison road. That road runs on toward the Rose.

variants.low: Old Imperial roads and a waystation. We use the old names. The Prison road runs toward the Rose.
variants.high: The Border road over our roofs is an old Imperial road, same as the Prison road. The Mile House is an old waystation. The old names stuck, so use them with the carters. The Tag House sits on a dry rise beside the Prison road. That road runs on toward the Rose.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
entries.words: Alten Corimont sits in the east of Shadowfen, a river port where the water flows seaward. Argonian smugglers and pirates run it. They take no side in a quarrel. Any crew may tie up at the docks. The gangs that dredge the lower channel are hired from those docks. The rest of the port reaches me only in what the hands say.

variants.low: Alten Corimont is a port. Argonian pirates and smugglers run it and take no side in any war. Any crew may tie up there. The dredging gangs are hired from its docks.
variants.high: The gang walk reaches Alten Corimont, a river port in the east of Shadowfen. Argonian pirates and smugglers run it. They take no side in any war. Any crew may tie up at the docks. The lower channel gangs are hired from them.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
entries.words: Gang Ground holds the camp where a dredging gang's relatives live. It's about forty years old. It stands on firm ground, with the Border road above it and the marsh below. The top terrace stays dry enough for the hatching shed, so that is where the clutch lies. The families have no mind to leave those eggs. My corner is on the lowest terrace, nearest the water.

variants.low: Gang Ground is the families' camp. It's forty years old, on firm ground by the Border road. The clutch lies in the hatching shed on the top terrace. The families stay by it.
variants.high: Gang Ground is the camp for a dredging gang's families, about forty years old. It stands on firm ground between the Border road and the marsh. The top terrace is dry enough for the hatching shed, where the clutch lies. The families stay by those eggs.

entries.speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
entries.words: The Border road above the camp is one of the old Imperial roads. So is the Prison road, which runs toward the Rose. The Mile House is a waystation of theirs. We still call them all by the old names, though the Empire is gone. The old ones say those roads rotted the cargo. The Tag House stands beside the Prison road on a dry rise.

variants.low: The Prison road is an old Imperial road toward the Rose. The Tag House stands beside it on a dry rise. People still use the old names.
variants.high: The Prison road, the Border road above us and the Mile House waystation are old Imperial work. People still use the old names. The Prison road runs toward the Rose. The Tag House stands beside it on a dry rise.
